_note: tier decides where a character appears. 'free' = playable, shown on the choose-your-character screen. 'premium' = shop characters (empty for now). 'clothing' = not playable, only used as an outfit source for clothing.js. 'npc' = staff and officers. Every character is a Mixamo .fbx body; every 'free' and 'premium' character can also give its clothes to others once it has a line in CLOTHES in clothing.js. To move a character, move its file into the matching folder and change its entry here.
